title: Policies effective.
bodyText: Any policy applied for by an original subscriber shall become effective concurrently with the issuance of a certificate of authority to the reciprocal insurer.
bodyHtml: §431:4-410  Policies effective.  Any policy applied for by an original subscriber shall become effective concurrently with the issuance of a certificate of authority to the reciprocal insurer. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
